title: Dragon in Parisian Street
description: A massive black dragon with glowing green eyes and orange fiery accents crawls across a wet cobblestone street in a European city. Behind it, a large semi-circular stained glass window depicting a colorful green dragon is mounted between buildings resembling Montmartre with the Sacré-Cœur Basilica visible in the background.
prompt: A gigantic black dragon with glowing green eyes and fiery orange highlights crawling on a wet Parisian cobblestone street, massive semi-circular stained glass window above it showing a detailed green dragon, Sacré-Cœur Basilica and classic Parisian buildings in the background, dramatic cloudy sky, people fleeing in the distance, cinematic lighting, highly detailed fantasy artwork
